macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Strong contrast between high-intensity (lighter) pixels in the muzzle/chin region and low-intensity (darker) pixels in the cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Pronounced vertical thickness of the lower lip with observable structural droop and exposure of lighter internal tissue pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white/light-grey pixel cluster localized to the mental (chin) region and lower oral commissure.
